eyebrow: A bucket policy — attached to the resource
code:
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/glue-etl-role" },
  "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::my-data-lake/curated/*"
}

Unlike an identity policy, Principal is required.
caption: Attached to the bucket, not to an identity.
